measurement: v2 models of record (A-CMB century / A-CMB-DU modern, manual edits), hazard track rebuilt on v2 blocks
published_risk_rule: argmin window log loss per combo; locked; evaluation scope 2006+; fitted candidates (p_pool) eligible only with >= 10 window events (minimum-events rule, adopted 2026-10-03 after the modern aut h1 pool failure); below 10 window events selection is suppressed and the product takes p_avg3 (equal-weight combination; forecast-combination-puzzle rule, adopted 2026-10-03 after the guarded run showed 8-event selection noise; all intermediate rules and outcomes are retained in the project record)
caveats: central 50% fan band under-covers (~0.33-0.36; shared by the unconditional benchmark); 90% band near-nominal
modern aut h1 is label-starved (18 training positives): published column is the equal-weight combination per the selector rule
per-block NAVAR ft_val is not comparable across blocks (masked loss divides by the dynamic-target count)
near-constant nodes (flagged in the leaderboard) have uninformative CRPS ratios
